subject: Request for additional evaluation credits — multiple teams
messages:
From: Nate Porter <nate@blueharbor.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request for additional evaluation credits — multiple teams

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well. We launched the internal pilots last week and several product teams at BlueHarbor are asking for more eval credits so they can complete their feature experiments before our Q1 planning cycle. Right now we’re hitting limits and a few teams have effectively paused their runs.

Can you approve an extra 200k tokens divided across three teams? I attached a breakdown of who needs what. We’re still evaluating; no purchase order yet — we wanted to see if Redwood can extend temporary credits to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Nate Porter
Head of Platform Engineering
BlueHarbor Labs

Attachments: blueharbor_request_details.xlsx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request for additional evaluation credits — multiple teams

Forwarding Nate’s note — flagged because this is a sizable request and it looks like BlueHarbor has had multiple separate trial top-ups over the last 6 months. Ben / Aditya, can you validate whether there’s any coordinated pattern (multi-team, multi-account) or obvious signs of promo stacking?

Ask:
- Ben: check CRM/deal history and past credit grants for this account
- Aditya: quick usage / IP distribution check; if you see anything odd please attach a snapshot

I’ll hold on responding to Nate until we have a quick read. If this is legitimate, we can offer a short paid pilot instead of comping additional credits.

Thanks — Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 10:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for additional evaluation credits — multiple teams

Quick update: I pulled the CRM record. BlueHarbor is on a free evaluation that started 2027-06-01; we granted an initial 150k token pilot and then an ad-hoc 75k top-up on 2027-09-12 after product demo requests. No active paid contracts on record. The contact list shows 4 separate requesters using different company emails (nate@ + ops@ + devops+team@ + analytics@).

This could be normal for larger orgs, but given the volume and that we’ve been granting small top-ups, want to be cautious. Recommend requiring org verification (PO or signature) for any >100k credit grants going forward.

-Ben
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for additional evaluation credits — multiple teams

Attached: blueharbor_usage_report_20271120.csv and suspicious-ips-snapshot.txt — I ran a quick query across the last 120 days. Flags:
- 3 distinct API keys tied to the account with overlapping token spikes the last 2 weeks
- Two source IP blocks belong to cloud-hosting providers not previously seen in our records (possible sandboxed or contractor accounts)
- Token consumption pattern shows short high-volume bursts consistent with scripted tests rather than organic interactive use

My recommendation: place a temporary hold on auto-comp credits, ask for PO or contract to continue, and escalate if they provide inconsistent identity info. I can follow up with an anonymized usage heatmap if useful.

- Aditya

Attachments: blueharbor_usage_report_20271120.csv; suspicious-ips-snapshot.txt
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nate Porter <nate@blueharbor.ai>, procurement@blueharbor.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 17:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request for additional evaluation credits — multiple teams

Hi Nate — thanks for the note and the details. We reviewed internal signals and usage patterns and want to be sure we’re doing this the right way for both teams. A few quick points:

- We’re happy to support a short paid pilot to keep your teams moving (we can credit back up to 50% of pilot spend once an enterprise commitment is in place).
- To approve non-trivial additional eval credits (>100k tokens) we require one of the following: a signed SOW/PO, or an explicit purchase intent email from a procurement owner plus an authorized billing contact.
- We noticed multiple email aliases and some activity from new IP ranges; as a precaution we’re placing a temporary hold on auto-credit grants for BlueHarbor until procurement/PO verification is provided. This is to prevent possible promo stacking while we confirm organizational ownership.

If you can route a PO or procurement confirmation to procurement@redwood.ai, we’ll expedite a pilot credit grant the same day. Alternatively, Marcus can set up a short paid pilot today and we’ll apply a partial credit if you convert.

Appreciate the partnership — we want to help you move quickly but need to follow the policy for larger grants.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: blueharbor_usage_report_20271120.csv, suspicious-ips-snapshot.txt
